capture_derived.FIRSTAWAKE: recorders in the order of their first recorded Awake (boot, setup, settle and earlier operation lists)
capture_derived.LASTENABLE: recorders in the order of their last recorded OnEnable before the operation
capture_derived.IDDESC: recorder components by actual instance id, descending (signed)
capture_derived.IDASC: recorder components by actual instance id, ascending (signed)
capture_derived.GOIDDESC: objects by actual GameObject instance id descending; component-list order inside an object
capture_derived.GOIDASC: objects by actual GameObject instance id ascending; component-list order inside an object
capture_derived.TRIDDESC: objects by actual Transform instance id descending; component-list order inside an object
capture_derived.TRIDASC: objects by actual Transform instance id ascending; component-list order inside an object

notes.scope: per case; the default-order recorder class only; no answer is extrapolated to other script types, execution orders, Destroy, re-parenting or other lifecycle paths
notes.ids: id hypotheses use the ids each capture records in diagnostics.jsonl; none are inferred from another probe or from document order
notes.first_wake: setup Awake order is recorded data; no child-first or parent-first rule is adopted
notes.particles: ParticleSystem reads observe one built-in; D-1 is not claimed for every OnEngineDisable override
